title: Working psychologically with serious and catastrophic injury

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，要是你们能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到更多钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，从2019年起我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开始接受报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在2022年完成这个项目的，此后也一直支持两期心理学家走过他们的转化之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体会客厅、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森礼品以及限时的一对一教练福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我都在这里。

sentences.en: What is the role for psychology in catastrophic injury cases?
sentences.zh: 心理学在灾难性伤害案件中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: And what is case management and how can that play out as a psychologist?
sentences.zh: 什么是病例管理，作为一名心理学家它又是如何发挥作用的？

sentences.en: That is what we are going to be exploring in today's episode as we meet a qualified clinical psychologist who specializes in all of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在今天的节目中要探讨的内容，我们将采访一位专精于此的合格临床心理学家。

sentences.en: There's so much to learn about compassion, dignity, respect, and doing a job well.
sentences.zh: 关于同理心、尊严、尊重以及如何把工作做好，有太多东西值得学习。

sentences.en: I hope you will find this so useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你会觉得这非常有用。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到“有志心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I am a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: One of my favourite things about psychology is just how people can take essentially the same qualification and turn it into something completely new and unique from what another qualified professional might be doing.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢心理学的一点，就是人们如何能拿着本质上相同的资格证书，把它变成与另一位合格专业人士所做的事情完全崭新且独特的东西。

sentences.en: That is exactly what is going to be happening today.
sentences.zh: 这正是今天将要发生的事情。

sentences.en: We're going to be meeting someone with the same professional qualification as me, which is clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们将采访一位和我拥有相同专业资格的人，也就是临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And we're going to be seeing about the work that she does and how she does it and why it lights her up.
sentences.zh: 我们将了解她从事的工作、她的工作方式以及为什么这份工作让她充满热情。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful and I'll look forward to catching you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得这很有用，我期待在节目另一端与你相聚。

sentences.en: Hi Shabnam, welcome along to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，沙布纳姆，欢迎来到本播客。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: It's exciting to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: So you are a qualified clinical psychologist, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 所以你是一位合格的临床心理学家，对吧？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 我是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I qualified in 2008, which makes me feel incredibly old, but I like to think of myself as wise and experienced now.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在2008年获得资格的，这让我觉得自己老得不可思议，但我现在喜欢认为自己既睿智又经验丰富。

sentences.en: So, yes, yes, I've been qualified for a little while.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，是的，我获得资格已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Could you tell us a little bit about your journey to psychology?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们讲讲你走上心理学之路的经历吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I recognise that psychology was something you can actually make a job out of when I was at school, aspiring to be a medical student, actually, and to be a doctor.
sentences.zh: 所以，我意识到心理学是可以真正当作一份工作来做的时候，我还在上学，当时其实梦想成为一名医学生，想当一名医生。

sentences.en: That was kind of my ambition at the time.
sentences.zh: 那算是我当时的志向吧。

sentences.en: And I realised quite soon into my A-levels that I'm not going to get there.
sentences.zh: 在读高中高级水准课程不久后，我意识到我实现不了这个目标了。

sentences.en: I'm not a straight A student.
sentences.zh: 我不是个门门都拿A的学生。

sentences.en: And also, I really don't understand chemistry and biology like I probably should if I'm going to be a medic.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果我要当一名医生的话，我对化学和生物的理解确实不如我应该达到的水平。

sentences.en: And then I started thinking about and I realised this is the first foray, I suppose, into understanding values and the importance of values.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始思考，我意识到这是我第一次尝试（我想是的）去理解价值观以及价值观的重要性。

sentences.en: I started thinking about, you know, what do I actually like doing?
sentences.zh: 我开始思考，你知道，我到底喜欢做什么？

sentences.en: What interests me?
sentences.zh: 什么能引起我的兴趣？

sentences.en: What gets me going?
sentences.zh: 什么能让我动力十足？

sentences.en: And I came to a bit of a dead end until at school someone came and spoke to me, spoke to the school about sort of like in a motivational interviewing kind of way,
sentences.zh: 我陷入了某种死胡同，直到在学校里有人来找我，用一种类似动机式访谈的方式和学校交流，

sentences.en: sort of motivational speaker.
sentences.zh: 有点像励志演讲者那种。

sentences.en: And I just thought, wow, to use words so powerfully to change how people feel is an incredible position to be in and how you can use that for good.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哇，如此强有力地使用语言来改变人们的感受，这是一个令人难以置信的崇高地位，你可以如何用它来做善事。

sentences.en: And I don't need anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不需要。

sentences.en: I just need my words.
sentences.zh: 我只需要我的语言。

sentences.en: And so that's kind of where the psychology came from, the idea of doing psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以心理学就是从那里开始的，从事心理学的想法也是。

sentences.en: So my first introduction into psychology was actually at university.
sentences.zh: 因此，我初次接触心理学实际上是在大学里。

sentences.en: And that's where I learned about clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里我了解到了临床心理学。

sentences.en: And my journey to clinical psychology was actually via a PhD.
sentences.zh: 我走向临床心理学的道路实际上是通过攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: And then I became, yeah, I got into clinical psychology training.
sentences.zh: 然后我成为了……是的，我进入了临床心理学培训。

sentences.en: And here I am doing two different things, but using very much psychology skills nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 现在我在这里做两件不同的事情，但毫无疑问都在很大程度上运用了心理学技能。

sentences.en: Thank you for that whistle-stop tossing.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这番精简的概括。

sentences.en: So you are Dr. Dr. Shabnam Berry Khan.
sentences.zh: 所以你是沙布纳姆·贝瑞·汗博士博士。

sentences.en: I am, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 看起来是的。

sentences.en: Or Dr. Square, as my friend calls me sometimes.
sentences.zh: 或者像我的朋友有时叫我的那样，平方博士。

sentences.en: Oh, amazing.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: You must have been a really good support to your cohort as well in terms of your academic rigour and your research skills too.
sentences.zh: 在你的学术严谨性和研究技能方面，你对你的同窗一定也是个很好的支持。

sentences.en: I know that I would have loved to have had somebody in that regard on our cohort too.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的同窗们也会非常渴望有这样一个人。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is a really good set of skills to have.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一套非常好的技能。

sentences.en: I don't necessarily think you need to do a PhD to have the, you know, to develop an interest and a passion for research.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你一定需要攻读博士学位才能培养对研究的兴趣和热情。

sentences.en: But I think that has carried through certainly that sort of background for sure.
sentences.zh: 但我认为那种背景确实传承了下来，那是肯定的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a good set of skills for sure.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这绝对是一套很好的技能。

sentences.en: It certainly is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: So let's have a think then, without obviously giving away any client case studies, because that wouldn't be appropriate.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来想一想，显然不能透露任何客户的案例研究，因为那是不合适的。

sentences.en: But could you give us a couple of examples about what serious and catastrophic injury looks like?
sentences.zh: 但你能给我们举几个例子，说明严重和灾难性伤害是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: Because that's the area that you're working in at the moment.
sentences.zh: 因为这是你目前正在从事的领域。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So I work both as a treating psychologist in the serious and catastrophic injury field and a case manager in the same field.
sentences.zh: 所以我既在严重和灾难性伤害领域担任治疗心理学家，又在该领域担任病例经理。

sentences.en: So it's sort of two ways into the same client group.
sentences.zh: 所以这是进入同一客户群体的两种不同途径。

sentences.en: But in terms of if I can give you a sort of a picture of the kind of work that we do do, and then hopefully that will bring, you know, a sort of helpful case study to mind.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果我能为你勾勒出我们所做工作的一个轮廓，希望这能让你脑海中浮现出一个有用的案例研究。

sentences.en: And so the work is very systemic.
sentences.zh: 这项工作具有很强的系统性。

sentences.en: It's ultimately so when we're thinking either about case management or treating psychology, you are working with people who have suffered a life changing injury.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，当我们考虑病例管理或治疗心理学时，你面对的是遭受了改变人生的伤害的人。

sentences.en: So that means that they are not living the life they would have had had it not been for the injury.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果没有这场伤害，他们现在过着的生活将截然不同。

sentences.en: And therefore, in order to rehabilitate or to try and achieve their life goals, which they should absolutely be supported to try and achieve.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了进行康复治疗，或者为了努力实现他们的人生目标，他们绝对应该得到支持去努力实现这些目标。

sentences.en: And there's an awful lot of systemic input that needs to go in.
sentences.zh: 并且需要投入大量的系统性干预。

sentences.en: So I'm talking about therapies, of course, care in my field, because they are seriously and catastrophically injured, often liable to someone else's mistake.
sentences.zh: 所以我在谈论治疗，当然还有在我这个领域的护理工作，因为他们遭受了严重和灾难性的伤害，往往是由别人的错误造成的。

sentences.en: There is a whole legal machine going on around them.
sentences.zh: 他们身边运转着一整套法律机器。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of there are a lot of people involved in trying to get someone to live the life they should have been living.
sentences.zh: 因此，有很多人参与其中，试图让某人过上他们本来应该过的生活。

sentences.en: And so as a case manager, you're managing that entire package.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一名病例经理，你要管理整个方案。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of formulation work that goes into kind of pulling all of that together.
sentences.zh: 把所有这些结合在一起需要做很多构想的工作。

sentences.en: As you can imagine, anyone who's kind of trained or interested in systemic working, there's a lot of interpersonal dynamic features that you draw upon.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，任何受过系统性工作培训或对此感兴趣的人，都会运用到许多人际动态特征。

sentences.en: And kind of pulling that story together, having a narrative that everyone's working towards is super important, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，把那个故事拼凑在一起，形成一个每个人都在努力实现的共同叙事是超级重要的。

sentences.en: And as a treating psychologist, you are then one of the team members.
sentences.zh: 作为一名治疗心理学家，你就是团队成员之一。

sentences.en: So you would be the treating psychologist supporting, again, usually the system as opposed to specifically the client.
sentences.zh: 所以你将是支持系统的治疗心理学家，同样，通常是支持整个系统，而不是专门针对客户。

sentences.en: Although there are obviously occasions where you are supporting the clients themselves if they have the capacity and the and the and the goals and the outcomes are related to specific work,
sentences.zh: 尽管显然在某些情况下，如果客户有能力、有目标，并且结果与具体工作相关，你也会直接支持客户本身，

sentences.en: you know, that they are that we're working on together.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是我们正在共同努力的事情。

sentences.en: So I guess I'm thinking if we work and we do work across the lifespan as well, but you can, you know, as you imagine,
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果我们工作的话——我们的确跨越了不同的年龄层进行工作——但你可以，正如你想象的那样，

sentences.en: the systemic focus is different when you're working with paediatric clients.
sentences.zh: 当你与儿科客户合作时，系统性的侧重点是不同的。

sentences.en: There is a lot of interagency working, there is a lot of interagency working, schools, sort of any community type input, statutory services, of course.
sentences.zh: 有大量的跨机构合作，有大量的跨机构合作，比如学校、任何社区类型的投入，当然还有法定服务。

sentences.en: Obviously, obviously, you've got the family who are in a very different position working with a child client than the family working, you know,
sentences.zh: 显然，与儿童客户合作时的家庭，跟我们与成年客户合作时的家庭，所处的立场截然不同。

sentences.en: when we're working with an adult client.
sentences.zh: 当我们与成年客户合作时。

sentences.en: So there's a there's a there's a there's already I hope that picture kind of suggests that your your your lens is quite broad while you have the potential depth to work with a client who perhaps is struggling with the injury that's happened to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，我希望这个画面能表明，虽然你有潜力深入处理可能正在与遭遇的伤害作斗争的客户的问题，但你的视野是相当广泛的。

sentences.en: That may not always be the case.
sentences.zh: 情况可能并非总是如此。

sentences.en: So the work that you do is often very systemic and very trauma and need needing to be trauma informed as well.
sentences.zh: 因此，你所做的工作通常具有很强的系统性、高度的创伤相关性，并且需要具备创伤知情意识。

sentences.en: In terms of a case specifically, a good example, perhaps of a case could be a particular client.
sentences.zh: 就具体案例而言，一个好的案例例子或许可以是一个特定的客户。

sentences.en: So I it's a case managed case that I work with and and and one of our treating psychologists is the the the psychologist on the team as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个我参与管理的病例，我们的一位治疗心理学家也是团队中的心理学家。

sentences.en: And the referral for psychology came through because the the clients, the client was experienced, was exhibiting behaviours of challenge.
sentences.zh: 心理学转诊的到来是因为客户、该客户经历过、表现出了具有挑战性的行为。

sentences.en: But in order to understand how how to to think about the function of that behaviour and the communications around it,
sentences.zh: 但为了理解如何思考该行为的功能以及围绕它的沟通，

sentences.en: there was a lot of interdisciplinary working with the speech and language therapist, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，这需要与言语和语言治疗师进行大量的跨学科合作。

sentences.en: For example, there was communications with the care team who through that discovery we work through those interactions,
sentences.zh: 例如，与护理团队进行了沟通，通过这一发现，我们通过这些互动，

sentences.en: we worked out that the care team actually didn't have a lot of brain injury experience.
sentences.zh: 我们发现护理团队实际上并没有多少脑损伤经验。

sentences.en: And this client was unfortunately did have a brain injury as a result of the the accident that happened.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这位客户确实由于发生的事故而遭受了脑损伤。

sentences.en: And the what was happening was that the staff retention was very poor as a result.
sentences.zh: 结果发生的情况是，员工留存率非常低。

sentences.en: And so the psychologist and as a case manager,
sentences.zh: 因此，心理学家和作为病例经理的我，

sentences.en: we were working in unison to try and understand how to create a stable team before we can even think about what the behaviours are about specifically,
sentences.zh: 我们在齐心协力地工作，试图理解如何在甚至开始具体思考这些行为究竟是关于什么之前，先建立一个稳定的团队，

sentences.en: because the system wasn't quite right.
sentences.zh: 因为系统还不够完善。

sentences.en: We had to get mum and dad on board with that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须让爸爸妈妈也参与进来。

sentences.en: And so there was lots of joint working and lots of thinking around how they were relating to what had happened to their family member.
sentences.zh: 因此，有很多共同努力，也有很多关于他们如何看待其家庭成员所遭遇的事情的思考。

sentences.en: We also had to check in a lot of a number of times with capacity.
sentences.zh: 我们还必须多次评估民事能力。

sentences.en: So the client, as I'm sure a lot of your audience will know, the capacity is time specific and decision specific.
sentences.zh: 所以客户，我确信你的很多听众都会知道，能力是具有时间特定性和决策特定性的。

sentences.en: So we had to really bring that into how we were thinking around the client's needs,
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须把这一点真正融入到我们对客户需求的思考方式中，

sentences.en: linking and obviously with the legal team who wanted to understand what we were doing and why we were doing it, as well as thinking with the rest of the sort of therapy team.
sentences.zh: 显然要与法律团队建立联系，他们想要了解我们在做什么以及我们为什么这样做，还要与其余的治疗团队共同思考。

sentences.en: So they understood how we were making sense of the behaviours, but needing to do this sort of pre-emptive piece around stabilising the system in which the client was operating.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能理解我们是如何解读这些行为的，但同时也需要围绕稳定客户身处其中的系统做这种前瞻性的工作。

sentences.en: It got really complicated at one point that between sort of the psychologist having a really strong formulation that everyone bought into and from which from which every there was a sort of shared understanding of what the goals are that were based on what the client was wanting.
sentences.zh: 有一次情况变得非常复杂，在心理学家提出了每个人都赞同的强有力的构想之后，所有人都能据此对基于客户意愿的目标达成一种共识。

sentences.en: We were able to, well, we still are navigating through how to work in unison and with the client rather than to the client.
sentences.zh: 我们能够——嗯，我们仍在摸索如何与客户并肩作战、共同努力，而不是把意愿强加给客户。

sentences.en: And so it's been a really long piece of work.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一项非常长期的工作。

sentences.en: I think that one of the biggest differences of working in our field is that there's a lot more liaison, particularly with the legal teams,
sentences.zh: 我认为在我们领域工作最大的不同之一，是有更多的联络工作，特别是与法律团队的联络，

sentences.en: because they're the ones who are collating all of this data that you're otherwise generating and having to justify it, either from a cost perspective or in terms of, well,
sentences.zh: 因为他们是整理你所生成的这些数据的人，你必须对其进行辩护，无论是从成本的角度还是从……嗯，

sentences.en: usually in a cost perspective, but in terms of clinical advantage.
sentences.zh: 通常是从成本角度，但也是从临床优势的角度。

sentences.en: Like, why would you spend that time thinking about stabilising the care team?
sentences.zh: 比如，你为什么要花时间去考虑稳定护理团队？

sentences.en: And so you end up being quite analytical in a different way to perhaps if you were working purely clinically with a client.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终会以一种与纯粹对客户进行临床工作时不同的方式变得相当具有分析性。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it does.
sentences.zh: 是的，说得通。

sentences.en: It's a very big job, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一份非常大的工作，对吧？

sentences.en: And one with many different plates spinning simultaneously, I think.
sentences.zh: 而且我想这是一份需要同时转动许多不同盘子的工作。

sentences.en: But, you know, I think what we're talking about here is like big accidents at work, big accidents in education settings.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我认为我们在这里讨论的是工作中的重大事故、教育环境中的重大事故。

sentences.en: Basically, anything that's not your fault that might be like a serious acquired brain injury or maybe even, you know, someone having to be a wheelchair user for life and or both.
sentences.zh: 基本上，任何不是你的错、可能是严重获得性脑损伤，或者甚至可能导致某人终身使用轮椅，或者两者兼有的情况。

sentences.en: That's kind of the level we're talking about here, is it, Shabnam?
sentences.zh: 沙布纳姆，这就是我们在这里讨论的级别，是吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Often our clients are injured as a result of medical negligence.
sentences.zh: 我们的客户往往是因为医疗疏忽而受伤。

sentences.en: So we get a lot of birth injuries, for example, or clinical negligence, you know, procedure going wrong and leaving someone either, as you say, with spinal cord injury,
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多产伤，例如，或者临床疏忽，你知道，某个医疗程序出错，正如你所说，给某人留下了脊髓损伤、

sentences.en: orthopaedic injuries or a brain injury is big, sadly.
sentences.zh: 骨科损伤，或者不幸的是严重的脑损伤。

sentences.en: And it could or it could be a road traffic accident.
sentences.zh: 或者也可能是道路交通事故。

sentences.en: That's our usual sort of sort of incident sort of, you know, categories, you could say.
sentences.zh: 这是我们通常的事故类别，你可以这么说。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: Things happen at work.
sentences.zh: 工作中会发生事情。

sentences.en: Things happen in other localities as well, settings.
sentences.zh: 其他地方和环境中也会发生事情。

sentences.en: So it's it's injuries can happen anywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以伤害可能发生在任何地方。

sentences.en: It's more prolific, I think, than we perhaps might otherwise imagine.
sentences.zh: 我认为这比我们想象的要普遍得多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And how do you keep so positive and hopeful for what might sometimes feel like a really, really emotive, challenging role that you're doing?
sentences.zh: 面对有时感觉非常非常情绪化、充满挑战的角色，你如何能保持如此积极和充满希望的心态？

sentences.en: I think I suppose it comes back to that values piece right at the beginning, really knowing what interests me and how I can make that operational in my life.
sentences.zh: 我想这可以追溯到最开始那个关于价值观的问题，真正了解什么能引起我的兴趣以及我如何在生活中将其付诸实践。

sentences.en: And it's taken me a really long time to get there because I didn't quite realize that was actually on the right lines way back when.
sentences.zh: 我花了很长时间才走到这一步，因为很久以前我并没有完全意识到自己其实走在正确的轨道上。

sentences.en: And then you get distracted, don't you?
sentences.zh: 然后你就会分心，对吧？

sentences.en: And then suddenly you're in that place of needing where it matters, because actually the clashes and the conflicts become more apparent.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，你就处在那种需要关怀、需要重视的境地，因为实际上各种冲突和矛盾变得更加明显了。

sentences.en: The, you know, the more you live life, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想，随着你经历的事情越多，生活阅历越丰富。

sentences.en: And then other priorities kick in family and, you know, just wanting to be me.
sentences.zh: 然后其他的生活重心就会接踵而至，比如家庭，还有，你知道的，就是单纯地想要做回自己。

sentences.en: Turns out that that's quite important.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这其实相当重要。

sentences.en: And I needed to build time in.
sentences.zh: 而且我需要为自己留出时间。

sentences.en: So I think there's several transitions that happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这里面发生了几次转变。

sentences.en: So it's not just, you know, the mindset side of things.
sentences.zh: 所以它不仅仅是心态层面上的转变，你知道的。

sentences.en: It was also kind of where I was working and how I wanted to work and where would I get that best work life balance.
sentences.zh: 这也关乎我当时在哪里工作、我想怎么工作，以及我在哪里能获得最佳的工作与生活平衡。

sentences.en: And and I think for me, I, I realized there was a gap in the market, so to speak, with in terms of psychology, supporting these catastrophically injured clients and thinking,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为对我来说，我意识到在心理学领域存在着一个所谓的市场空白，专门用来支持这些遭受灾难性伤害的客户，然后我想，

sentences.en: why is there a gap in the market?
sentences.zh: 为什么市场上会有这样的空白？

sentences.en: This is outrageous.
sentences.zh: 这太离谱了。

sentences.en: But I was working as a case manager at the time, so it was my way in.
sentences.zh: 但我当时是一名个案经理，所以这就是我的切入点。

sentences.en: But I kind of smelt what sold, so to speak, to use an Alan sugar term.
sentences.zh: 但我差不多摸清了什么东西好卖，借用阿兰·萨加尔（Alan Sugar）的一句话来说。

sentences.en: And it was quite clear that, you know, that this service was not available either in the NHS in that long term way.
sentences.zh: 很明显，你知道的，无论是国民保健制度（NHS）那种长期的服务，还是其他地方，都没有提供这种服务。

sentences.en: And it wasn't otherwise seemingly obviously available in the private sector.
sentences.zh: 而且在私营部门里，似乎也没有这种显而易见的服务。

sentences.en: And so that positivity comes from, I think, wanting good things for our clients.
sentences.zh: 所以这种积极性，我认为是源于希望我们的客户能有好的结果。

sentences.en: But in the process of that and giving things to our clients that they need and the systems around them, but also being able to, you know,
sentences.zh: 但在这一过程中，我们要给予客户他们所需要的东西以及他们周边的支持系统，同时也要能够，你知道的，

sentences.en: kind of have something that's reasonable for me as well to be able to stay in.
sentences.zh: 为自己争取一些合理的待遇，以便能够坚持做下去。

sentences.en: But I don't know.
sentences.zh: 不过我不知道。

sentences.en: Am I really answering your question?
sentences.zh: 我真的回答了你的问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 对，我不知道。

sentences.en: No, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没有。

sentences.en: You are.
sentences.zh: 你回答了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think you're also illuminating.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我觉得你很有启发性。

sentences.en: Some people say if you can't see it, you can't be it.
sentences.zh: 有些人说，如果你看不到它，你就无法成为它。

sentences.en: But you're actually wrecking that you're saying, well, I can see I can't see it, so I can be it.
sentences.zh: 但你实际上打破了这种说法，你说，好吧，我能看到我看不见的东西，所以我可以成为它。

sentences.en: And you've kind of given yourself permission to go out there and create that unique service for that niche that was already there that nobody really noticed was there.
sentences.zh: 你实际上是给自己许可，去走出去，为那个已经存在但没有人真正注意到的细分领域创造那种独特的服务。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And I think when you when you are in touch with that passion and when you are in touch with that desire to help, which is obviously why we do what we do.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，当你真正触及那种热情，当你真正触及那种助人的渴望时——显然这就是我们从事这份工作的原因。

sentences.en: Ultimately, I think it was it was obviously a bit easier because I sort of fell into the case management world and then realize, gosh,
sentences.zh: 最终，我觉得这其实稍微容易了一些，因为我算是误打误撞进入了个案管理的世界，然后意识到，天哪，

sentences.en: there's this area that I can really help with.
sentences.zh: 原来这里有一个我可以真正提供帮助的领域。

sentences.en: And I suppose it took courage to be able to do that as well.
sentences.zh: 我想，要做到这一点也需要勇气。

sentences.en: But I think I think it yeah, it's and it's really challenged me in terms of kind of thinking outside of what I've been trained to do and thinking, oh,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，这确实非常具有挑战性，它迫使我跳出受过的专业训练去思考，并且心想，哦，

sentences.en: got to think about other things like.
sentences.zh: 我还得考虑其他事情，比如。

sentences.en: KPIs and, you know, how do I be the how can I run some how can I create something that also doesn't lose me in it,
sentences.zh: 关键绩效指标（KPI），还有，你知道的，我要怎么成为——我该如何运营某些业务，如何创造一种既不会让我迷失其中，

sentences.en: but how do I get others to sort of how can I use the resources that are out there in the world to be able to help?
sentences.zh: 又能让其他人参与进来，以及如何利用这个世界上现有的资源来提供帮助呢？

sentences.en: So, you know, where I didn't think I was a creative person, I'm actually creative in this way, I think, you know, don't give me, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，过去我认为自己不是一个有创造力的人，但现在我觉得自己在这种事情上很有创造力，你看，千万别让我，你知道的，

sentences.en: any drawing material because I will not draw anything for you.
sentences.zh: 去拿任何画画的材料，因为我是绝不会为你画出任何东西的。

sentences.en: That's, you know, resembles anything that I say I'm drawing.
sentences.zh: 那些画，你知道的，根本不像我嘴里说正在画的任何东西。

sentences.en: But, you know, the creative element in me comes out, I think, here when we're talking about how to create something to offer people that they wouldn't otherwise get, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我身上的创造力元素在这里显现出来了，当我们讨论如何创造一些东西来为人们提供他们平时可能无法获得的服务时。

sentences.en: And yeah, that that's massively motivating for me.
sentences.zh: 是的，这对我来说是极大的激励。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I also don't think I'm particularly creative, but there are many, many things I do create.
sentences.zh: 而且我也觉得自己并不是特别有创造力，但我确实创造了很多很多东西。

sentences.en: And for listeners, the podcast, they will have probably maybe already listened to an episode, which, as we record, is coming out imminently,
sentences.zh: 对于听众朋友们来说，这个播客节目大家可能已经收听过其中某一期了，在我们录音的时候，它即将发布，

sentences.en: but isn't currently available right now.
sentences.zh: 不过目前还无法收听。

sentences.en: But it's with Juliet, Dr. Juliet, who is creative clinical psychologist over on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 但这期节目采访的是朱丽叶（Juliet），朱丽叶博士，她是Instagram上的一位富有创造力的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: And she's wonderfully creative.
sentences.zh: 她非常有创造力。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've seen her drawings, but she's they're so good.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有看过她的画作，但它们真的太棒了。

sentences.en: They're so good.
sentences.zh: 真的太棒了。

sentences.en: You should check them out.
sentences.zh: 你应该去看看。

sentences.en: I'll send you a link.
sentences.zh: 我会把链接发给你。

sentences.en: I think she's so good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她太优秀了。

sentences.en: And the way that she kind of depicts clients experiences.
sentences.zh: 还有她描绘客户经历的方式。

sentences.en: So she's currently working with services with children and asylum seekers and the way that she kind of weaves that into her work.
sentences.zh: 她目前正在为儿童和寻求庇护者提供服务，她把这种关怀完美地融入到了她的工作中。

sentences.en: But she also makes the work available for people to be able to use with their clients as well.
sentences.zh: 但她同时也把这些工作成果公之于众，让人们也能在与自己的客户交流时使用。

sentences.en: Like, but I love that she's a clinical psychologiSt. I'm a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 就像，我特别喜欢她是名临床心理学家。我是一名临床心理学家。你也是一名临床心理学家。

sentences.en: You're a clinical psychologiSt. But we all do different things, you know, that speak to our individual passions and our callings.
sentences.zh: 但我们都在做不同的事情，你知道的，这些事情契合了我们各自的热情和使命。

sentences.en: It's so important, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这不是很重要吗？

sentences.en: We're not just cookie cutter clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我们可不是那种千篇一律的标准化临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I 100 percent agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我对此百分之百赞同。

sentences.en: In fact, you could argue, I mean, of my caseload, the bigger part of it is case management, which I didn't know about when I was training.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你可以这样认为，在我的工作量中，很大一部分其实是个案管理，而我在受训时对这方面一无所知。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: And I think we can also lend our skills to not just like sort of therapeutic endeavors, but there are other ways that we can use our skills.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们不仅可以把技能运用到某种治疗性质的探索中，还有很多其他方式可以使用我们的技能。

sentences.en: And I think that's the really exciting bit about being a psychologist in training now compared to back, you know, when I was doing it, it was a bit more sort of standardized,
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是现在成为一名见习心理学最令人兴奋的地方，相比之下，回想当年我接受培训的时候，形式要更标准化一些，

sentences.en: if you like.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: But now I think, you know, there's a bit more acceptance that there are lots of different ways to do psychology and they're all legitimate.
sentences.zh: 但现在我认为，你知道的，大家更加认同从事心理学研究有许多不同的途径，而且它们都是合法且合理的。

sentences.en: And I think it's it means that you from the probably from training onwards, you get to think like that from the off, whereas I think I'm not sure that that was so strongly felt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这意味着，你可能从培训一开始就能带着这种思维方式去思考，而我并不确定当年是否有这么强烈的感受。

sentences.en: At least certainly I didn't feel that particularly strongly when I was training.
sentences.zh: 至少在我受训的时候，我确实没有这种特别强烈的感受。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm kind of envious of trainees now in a way that, you know, if that's indeed how it sounds like it might be.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，某种程度上我很羡慕现在的见习生，如果实际情况确实如听起来的那样的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the pandemic has really exploded and advanced all of this, hasn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得疫情确实彻底颠覆并推动了这一切的发展，不是吗？

sentences.en: With the way that people are working and with their, yeah, like some some people have kind of myself included no longer work for the NHS at all, you know, or other organizations.
sentences.zh: 通过人们的工作方式，以及，是的，就像有些人——包括我在内——已经完全不再为NHS或其他任何组织工作了，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know, they might only be self-employed, but many clinicians are doing a little bit of both, you know, a bit of employed work and a bit of a bit of their own work as well.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们可能只做自由职业，但很多临床医生会两边兼顾，你知道的，既做受雇的工作，也做一点自己的事情。

sentences.en: And it's, I think, encouraging us to use our psychology skills in ways that suit ourselves as well as the needs of our clients.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这正在鼓励我们以既适合自己、又满足客户需求的方式来运用我们的心理学技能。

sentences.en: And it's really empowering.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人充满力量。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是的。

sentences.en: In fact, I had a call earlier today with someone who was interested in working as an associate for us.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我今天早些时候和一个对在我们这里担任合作者（associate）感兴趣的人通过电话。

sentences.en: And we we provide quite a lot of information up to the point of, you know, deciding if we're aligned in terms of our intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了相当多的信息，直到我们决定彼此在兴趣方面是否合拍为止。

sentences.en: And one of her reflections was that it feels like not everyone can work in the field that you work in.
sentences.zh: 她的其中一个感悟是，感觉好像并不是每个人都能在你所从事的领域里工作。

sentences.en: And I thought that's exactly why we produce all this information.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这正是我们发布所有这些信息的目的所在。

sentences.en: We don't want to waste anyone's time.
sentences.zh: 我们不想浪费任何人的时间。

sentences.en: And we certainly do not want to put our clients in a position where they're working with someone who then pulls out because it's not a good fit for them.
sentences.zh: 我们当然也不希望将客户置于这样一种境地：他们合作的人后来因为发现不太合适而选择退出。

sentences.en: So in a way, we are requiring our associates to kind of know themselves as well and know what their passions are, know what their interests are.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，我们也要求我们的合作者必须了解自己，知道自己的热情所在，清楚自己的兴趣点在哪里。

sentences.en: And know that working certainly in our field with the systemic focus does require home visits, for example.
sentences.zh: 并且要明白，在我们的领域工作，尤其是注重系统性方法的领域，确实需要进行家访，比如。

sentences.en: It does require creative thinking, training for care teams, psychoeducation for the families, all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 这确实需要创造性的思维、为护理团队提供培训、为家属提供心理教育，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And in a way that if you can explain it and justify it through your clinical formulation, pretty much if it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 而且在某种程度上，如果你能通过你的临床个案构思来解释并证明它是合理的，只要它说得通。

sentences.en: And there is that motivation from the client themselves.
sentences.zh: 并且客户本人也有这样的动力。

sentences.en: The funding will probably be there to be able to kind of work through those challenges and those goals that have been identified, which is an incredible way to work.
sentences.zh: 那么资金很可能就会到位，从而能够去攻克那些已被确定的挑战和目标，这真是一种不可思议的工作方式。

sentences.en: And like you, I'm not in the NHS anymore, and it's been a little while since I have been, but it does feel like it's almost, you know, very different.
sentences.zh: 和你一样，我也不在NHS工作了，而且离开已经有一段时间了，但感觉确实几乎完全不同了，你知道的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just very different to how we've been trained to work, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 是的，它就是跟我们以往接受的工作培训大不相同，我想是这样的。

sentences.en: And so that creativity does need to be sort of on point in a way.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种创造力在某种程度上确实需要保持在线。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you know, you can work in similar ways in the NHS, but just not for the length of time, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，你知道的，你也可以在NHS以类似的方式工作，只是我觉得无法维持那么长的周期。

sentences.en: Certainly that's a feedback I've heard from associates and that I've experienced myself that it's not a sort of 12 sessions limitation due to, you know,
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我从合作者那里听到以及我自己亲身经历过的反馈，那就是它不像那种由于资金问题，

sentences.en: funding issues or just the way, you know, the system's set up.
sentences.zh: 或者仅仅是因为系统设置的方式，而导致的12次会话的限制。

sentences.en: It's so much more than that.
sentences.zh: 情况要丰富得多。

sentences.en: And if it's justifiable and it makes sense to the client and it ultimately, as we often say with psychology, prevents other problems from happening a bit later down the line,
sentences.zh: 如果这是合理的，对客户来说合乎情理，并且最终正如我们经常在心理学中说的那样，能够防止以后出现更多问题，

sentences.en: it's worth front loading if you get the psychology support so that you prevent other things from happening later on.
sentences.zh: 那么前期投入心理学支持是完全值得的，这样就能防患于未然。

sentences.en: And you get that stability, which obviously our clients need and deserve.
sentences.zh: 而且你还能获得那种稳定性，这显然是我们的客户所需要也应得的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, anyone.
sentences.zh: 好吧，无论是谁。

sentences.en: I've lost none of us are, you know, can control or predict the future.
sentences.zh: 我失去了——我们当中没有人能够控制或预测未来。

sentences.en: It's, you know, we have to be kind of entering into this work thinking that we can go the distance because I'm thinking that some of these cases, maybe even, I don't know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们在开展这项工作时必须抱着能够奉陪到底的心态，因为我在想，其中一些案例，甚至可能，我不知道，

sentences.en: five years, is it like, you know, how long is the longest case you could work with?
sentences.zh: 长达五年？就像，你知道的，你能接手的最长个案是多久？

sentences.en: Or could it be longer than that?
sentences.zh: 或者会不会比那更长？

sentences.en: Really good question.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好问题。

sentences.en: So my longest standing case management client, because it's a lifelong injury, as you say, and I started working with them as a paediatric when they were a child.
sentences.zh: 所以，我手头资历最深的个案管理客户，因为正如你所说，这是一次终身性的伤害，我开始为他们服务时他们还是儿科患者，是个孩子。

sentences.en: And I have been with them for the last 14 years, and it doesn't look like we're going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我已经陪伴他们度过了过去的14年，而且看起来我们的合作还将继续下去。

sentences.en: So we're talking very long term.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论的是非常长期的项目。

sentences.en: Psychology, our treating psychology work is a bit different.
sentences.zh: 心理学，我们开展的治疗性心理学工作则略有不同。

sentences.en: But there are clients who, because of the nature of their circumstances and the complexity around them, easily a couple of years of different things, you know,
sentences.zh: 但有些客户，由于他们所处的环境性质以及周围情况的复杂性，轻轻松松就需要持续好几年不同形式的服务，你知道的，

sentences.en: working in different ways.
sentences.zh: 以不同的方式开展工作。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: So for a case where you might be working with somebody with a legal team and case management for 10 years, ultimately,
sentences.zh: 因此，对于一个你可能需要与法律团队和个案管理人员合作长达10年的个案来说，归根结底，

sentences.en: the goal would be that there'd be some sort of settlement and then the case management aspect would stop or not.
sentences.zh: 其目标是最终达成某种和解，然后个案管理的方面就会终止，或者也不会终止？

sentences.en: What does that involve?
sentences.zh: 这其中包含哪些内容？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it really depends.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这真的视情况而定。

sentences.en: So it depends on things like what their experience was up to the point of settling, whether case management and the support they got was consistent and safe, felt safe for them.
sentences.zh: 所以它取决于诸如他们在达成和解之前的经历、个案管理以及他们得到的支持是否持续且安全——对他们来说是否有安全感。

sentences.en: It might be, it might depend on how well the evidence was collated up to the point of settlement, because, of course, post settlement,
sentences.zh: 它可能还取决于在达成和解之前证据收集得有多好，因为当然，在和解之后，

sentences.en: then the compensation will be whatever size it will be accordingly.
sentences.zh: 那么赔偿金就会相应地达到某种数额。

sentences.en: But obviously, if there isn't any data and the engagement hasn't been there in order to get that data, it might be that the compensation is a small award, ultimately,
sentences.zh: 但显然，如果没有相关数据，并且缺乏配合来获取这些数据，最终赔偿金可能只是一笔小数目，

sentences.en: and that can't afford case management or other parts of the package.
sentences.zh: 这样就无法承担个案管理或其他后续支持服务的费用。

sentences.en: And so there are big decisions to be made at the point of settlement, but often,
sentences.zh: 因此，在达成和解的节点上，有许多重大的决定需要做出，但通常情况下，

sentences.en: if there is a case manager involved and engagement is pretty decent from the clients and the family, and of course,
sentences.zh: 如果有案管人员介入，并且客户及其家属的配合度相当不错，当然，

sentences.en: the case manager is able to get the relevant data from other parts of the system, like the care teams and therapy teams, and can coordinate that well, more often than not,
sentences.zh: 如果案管人员能够从系统其他部分（如护理团队和治疗团队）获取相关数据并能很好地进行协调，十有八九，

sentences.en: the compensation will allow for the relationships to continue post settlement.
sentences.zh: 赔偿金将允许这些合作关系在和解后继续维持下去。

sentences.en: And so, because of the understanding that it's a lifelong condition, yeah, that they will, you know, they would need support for life.
sentences.zh: 因此，基于这是一项终身状况的共识，是的，他们将需要终身的支持。

sentences.en: Okay, so when you say data, it's making me think about something I heard on the Jeremy Vine show the other day, where it's saying that currently there's some health workers taking,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以当你提到数据时，让我想起了前几天我在杰里·维恩（Jeremy Vine）节目中听到的一件事，上面说目前有一些医护人员，

sentences.en: I think it's the government to, to the high courts over long COVID.
sentences.zh: 我想是由于“长期新冠”后遗症问题，正在将政府告上高等法院。

sentences.en: But that's very tricky, but that's very tricky, because they'd need to be able to prove without doubt, that this had happened as a result of,
sentences.zh: 但这非常棘手，因为他们需要能够毫无疑问地证明，这种情况的发生是由于——

sentences.en: they'd caught COVID as a result of their work, that they hadn't caught it elsewhere, for example.
sentences.zh: 他们是因为工作而感染了新冠，而不是在其他地方感染的，举个例子。

sentences.en: So when you're talking about data, that would be the data that they'd be having to produce, which is very tricky to do, because even, you know, because we just,
sentences.zh: 所以当你在谈论数据时，这就是他们必须出示的数据，而这做起来非常棘手，因为即使，你知道的，因为我们只是——

sentences.en: you can't know that for sure, you can say on the balance probability, but for that sort of case, you have to be certain.
sentences.zh: 你无法百分之百确定，你只能说根据概率平衡来看，但对于那种案件，你必须确凿无疑。

sentences.en: So is that what you mean by the data, some stuff to back up your claim that it was, it was someone else's responsibility rather than the person?
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你所指的数据吗？一些用来支撑你主张的材料，证明这是别人的责任而不是当事人的责任？

sentences.en: So when a case manager is involved, it's after the point of liability being assigned.
sentences.zh: 当一个案管人员介入时，那是在责任已经被认定之后的事了。

sentences.en: So that bit that you're talking about is quite early on in the spec, you know, in the sort of pathway in the life cycle of a case manager's involvement.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才谈论的那部分，其实是在个案管理介入周期的非常早期阶段。

sentences.en: So once liability has been assigned to someone else causing the injuries, money is then released in order to allow rehabilitation to commence, because these cases go on,
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦责任被判定是由其他人造成了这些伤害，资金就会随之发放，以便康复治疗得以展开，因为这些案件会持续很长时间，

sentences.en: can go on for years.
sentences.zh: 可能会持续好几年。

sentences.en: Someone can't wait for rehabilitation for that long.
sentences.zh: 一个人不可能等康复治疗等那么久。

sentences.en: So some funds are released, and the idea is that those funds being released creates clinical data, outcome data,
sentences.zh: 所以会有部分资金拨付下来，其理念是这笔资金的发放会产生临床数据、结果数据，

sentences.en: it produces evidence to demonstrate that the client actually needs that support.
sentences.zh: 它会产生证据来证明客户确实需要这种支持。

sentences.en: And so that's the data, I mean, that feeds back into the litigation strategy, that then gets chewed over by the litigators, and of course, the defence solicitors,
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的数据，它会回传给诉讼战略部门，然后由诉讼律师们仔细斟酌，当然还有被告方的辩护律师，

sentences.en: to work out whether that's justifiable, whether that's not justifiable, whether that's been helpful, whether it's not been helpful.
sentences.zh: 来评估这是合理的还是不合理的，是有帮助的还是没有帮助的。

sentences.en: And that's partly why the legal case can go on for so long, because you need to work out over a period of time, just how much is needed.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么法律诉讼会持续这么长时间的部分原因，因为你需要经过一段时间来评估到底需要多少资源。

sentences.en: And obviously, clients need to change, people can start improving and making positive changes, others decline because of, you know, health conditions that ensue after their injury,
sentences.zh: 很显然，客户的情况会发生变化，有些人开始好转并做出积极的改变，而另一些人则由于受伤后引发的健康状况而出现恶化，

sentences.en: so on and so forth, complications and all sorts.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类，并发症以及各种情况。

sentences.en: And so there needs to be a reasonable picture over a period of time as to what has been going on.
sentences.zh: 因此，需要有一段时间内关于所发生事情的合理全貌。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: I'm with you, yes.
sentences.zh: 我懂了，是的。

sentences.en: So the data might be, for example, actually physiotherapy five times a week, and speech and language therapy twice a week, is keeping this client rehabilitating,
sentences.zh: 所以这些数据可能，举个例子，实际上是每周五次物理治疗以及每周两次言语和语言治疗，正在让这位客户持续康复，

sentences.en: and to withdraw that would be detrimental to their well-being.
sentences.zh: 而撤回这一支持会对他们的福祉产生不利影响。

sentences.en: So we need to make sure there's enough budget for that to continue.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要确保有足够的预算让它继续下去。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And the experts that come in and get that snapshot picture of the client will have the view of across their lifespan.
sentences.zh: 那些前来并为客户拍摄快照的专家们，将拥有贯穿他们一生的全局视野。

sentences.en: And so it needs to be scaled up for the X number of years that this person is expected to live.
sentences.zh: 因此，它需要根据这个人预计生存的若干年进行相应扩展。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, in some cases, injuries can be life-limiting.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，在某些情况下，伤情可能会限制寿命。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for clearing that up for us and really clarifying and helping us paint that picture.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你为我们澄清这一点，并真正地阐明和帮助我们勾勒出这幅图景。

sentences.en: Could you give us and our listeners your top tip for reducing burnout when you are an aspiring psychologist or mental health professional?
sentences.zh: 对于立志成为心理学家或心理健康专业人士的听众，您能给我们和听众分享一个减少职业倦怠的最佳建议吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think, so my top tips would be, whatever you do, make sure that there's space for you in that, that offer.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为，我的首要建议是，无论你做什么，确保在这个方案、这个产品中为你自己留出空间。

sentences.en: And I think it's very easy to get carried away with your passions, with your interests, for filling a gap in the market, if you like, for, you know, with all that enthusiasm.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，带着所有的热情，很容易就被你的激情、你的兴趣所吞没，或者去填补所谓的市场空白。

sentences.en: And it's very easy to get to a point of recognising that, actually, I haven't built into this picture what I need in order to sustain all of that good stuff.
sentences.zh: 并且很容易到达这样一个认知点：事实上，为了维持所有这些美好的事情，我并没有将我所需要的东西构建到这个蓝图中。

sentences.en: Because the chances are, if it's, you know, something you're doing, it's probably going to be benefiting other people.
sentences.zh: 因为很有可能，如果这是你正在做的事情，它大概率会造福其他人。

sentences.en: You don't want to do that for a short term.
sentences.zh: 你不会只想做短期。

sentences.en: You want to do it for the long term.
sentences.zh: 你是想做长期的。

sentences.en: So build, you know, be okay about building yourself into, you know, what that model is going to look like, ultimately.
sentences.zh: 所以要建立，你知道的，坦然地把自己构建到最终呈现的那个模式中去。

sentences.en: Part-time working, full-time working, family commitments, you know, so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 兼职工作、全职工作、家庭责任，等等，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And I would say, related to that, you don't have to do everything yourself.
sentences.zh: 我想说，与此相关的是，你不需要什么都自己干。

sentences.en: Asking for help, sort of delegating to specialists out there that can help you.
sentences.zh: 寻求帮助，把工作委派给能帮到你的专业人士。

sentences.en: And I always use the example of a virtual assistant.
sentences.zh: 我总是举虚拟助理的例子。

sentences.en: You know, it's, I mean, they are a godsend, frankly.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，说实话，他们简直就是上天恩赐的宝藏。

sentences.en: Having someone who can assist you to do the things that, let's face it, I'm no good at, because I'm a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 找一个能协助你做那些说实话我不擅长的事情的人，因为我是个心理学家。

sentences.en: I can do that bit.
sentences.zh: 那部分我能做。

sentences.en: Not so good at keeping my diary.
sentences.zh: 记日程不太擅长。

sentences.en: Well, you know that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你是知道的。

sentences.en: I thought we were meeting half an hour earlier than we actually were.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们开会的时间比实际早了半小时。

sentences.en: But, yeah, people like me need a VA.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，像我这样的人需要一个虚拟助理。

sentences.en: And I can spend a very long time focusing on things that get me stressed out, number one.
sentences.zh: 首先，我可以花很长时间专注于那些让我倍感压力的杂事。

sentences.en: And number two, aren't going to get done well, let's be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 第二，说实话，那些事也干不好。

sentences.en: And number three, take away from the actual thing that I can do, my specialism, if you will.
sentences.zh: 第三，这会分散我做真正擅长的事——也就是我的专业领域的精力。

sentences.en: And so outsourcing is okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，外包是完全可以的。

sentences.en: It might cost, but it's worth doing that cost-benefit analysis in terms of, well, what can I gain if I'm freed up for that hour?
sentences.zh: 这可能会有成本，但从“如果我在这一个小时里被解放出来，我能收获什么”的角度来做成本效益分析是值得的。

sentences.en: Help me with that.
sentences.zh: 帮我处理好这些。

sentences.en: But that also means that I can think about doing something else.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也意味着我可以考虑去做别的事情。

sentences.en: And that something else might not even be, you know, a business something else.
sentences.zh: 而那别的事情甚至可能不是什么商业事务。

sentences.en: It might just be I can go for that walk that I keep saying I want to go and do.
sentences.zh: 可能只是去散步，也就是我一直说想去进行的那种散步。

sentences.en: So those would be my two main sort of suggestions, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想这两点就是我的两个主要建议。

sentences.en: They're not sort of typical self-care and, you know, ideas that you would, you know, kind of, you know,
sentences.zh: 它们不是那种典型的自我关照，也不是你会想到的那种……

sentences.en: there's not the go for a swim and, you know, go to go to the gym sort of ones.
sentences.zh: 不是去游个泳、去健身房之类的那种。

sentences.en: But I think for me, they've really helped ground me and helped me feel very sort of aware of what is important to me.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得对我而言，它们确实帮我稳住阵脚，让我非常清楚什么对我是重要的。

sentences.en: But I think in, I suppose the, I suppose it could be a third thing, but it's kind of interlinked.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，或许还可以算作第三点，但它们其实是环环相扣的。

sentences.en: It's just you start then finding people who are like you when you know what your values are, you know, and you're giving time for yourself to be able to be expressed.
sentences.zh: 那就是，当你清楚自己的价值观，并且留出时间来表达自我时，你就会开始吸引那些与你相似的人。

sentences.en: And then you end up sort of connecting with people who, you know, that you align with.
sentences.zh: 最终你会与那些志同道合的人建立联系。

sentences.en: And that's a really nice way to live life.
sentences.zh: 那真的是一种很美好的生活方式。

sentences.en: I think good people, you know, good balance and space to do whatever you need to do as well,
sentences.zh: 我认为有优秀的人，有良好的平衡，也有空间去做好你需要做的事，这也很重要。

sentences.en: because it, you know, it's that oxygen mask on your face before you start helping other people's scenario, which I'm sure many people have said in your podcasts over the years.
sentences.zh: 因为这就好比在开始帮助别人之前，先给自己戴上氧气面罩的情境，我相信多年来在你的播客里很多人都说过这一点。

sentences.en: It really matters, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 这真的很重要，对吧？

sentences.en: It really, really matters.
sentences.zh: 真的很重要，非常重要。

sentences.en: That's my version of it, I would say.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的版本，可以说。

sentences.en: As it turns out, I am also swimming a lot more than I used to, which is really, really great.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我现在游泳的频率也比过去高得多，这真的非常非常棒。

sentences.en: And that helps with, you know, with that side of things as well, in terms of physical exercise and, well, yeah, that side of things.
sentences.zh: 而且这也有助于处理那方面的事情，在身体锻炼以及，嗯，是的，那方面的事情上。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And if people want to know more about you and your case management or case management as a topic, I know at one stage you had a podcast called The Psychology of Case Management.
sentences.zh: 如果人们想更多地了解你和你的个案管理，或者将个案管理作为一个话题，我知道你曾经主持过一个名为《个案管理的心理学》的播客。

sentences.en: Can people still listen to that?
sentences.zh: 人们现在还能听到吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's on the website.
sentences.zh: 可以，在官网上。

sentences.en: It's under our resources tab.
sentences.zh: 在我们的资源标签页下。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a whole load of information on there.
sentences.zh: 是的，上面有大量的相关信息。

sentences.en: There's various articles and fact sheets about working in the serious and catastrophic injury space
sentences.zh: 有各种关于在严重和灾难性伤害领域工作的文章和资料单页。

sentences.en: with that psychological spin, of course, because that's our jam at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 当然带有心理学的视角，因为归根结底这就是我们的拿手好戏。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it's a really great field to, you know, if anyone's looking for, you know, sort of paid assistant work.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，如果有人在寻找带薪助理性质的工作，这是一个非常棒的领域。

sentences.en: Case management is a really interesting field.
sentences.zh: 个案管理是一个非常有趣的领域。

sentences.en: Even if it's not psychology in the treating psychology sense, it's absolutely a field that you get to learn a lot about.
sentences.zh: 即使它不是治疗心理学意义上的心理学，也绝对是一个能让你学到很多的领域。

sentences.en: Rehabilitation, brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, et cetera, and systemic working, ultimately.
sentences.zh: 康复、脑损伤、脊髓损伤等等，最终还有系统化工作。

sentences.en: Such important work.
sentences.zh: 如此重要的工作。

sentences.en: And you are over on LinkedIn, which is where I first connected to you.
sentences.zh: 而且你在领英上很活跃，我就是在那儿第一次和你建立联系的。

sentences.en: Your company is called Psych Works Associates.
sentences.zh: 你的公司叫作“心理学工作者合伙人”（Psych Works Associates）。

sentences.en: And on LinkedIn, you are Dr. Shabnam Berry Calm with a hyphen, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 在领英上，你是带连字符的 Shabnam Berry-Calm 博士，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, Clinical Psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”计划现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，如课程、会员项目和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我在 2022 年亲自完成了该计划，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.

sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊会、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森（Fortnum and Mason）的美味礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。
